source_descriptions.source-stripe-billing-apis: Stripe's Billing API overview relates the 11 subscription, billing, payment, customer, and entitlement objects. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-billing-collection-method: Stripe's Billing collection-method guide describes `charge_automatically` and `send_invoice` for invoices and subscriptions. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-billing-customer-tax-ids: Stripe Billing's customer tax ID guide covers storing, validating, and rendering customer tax IDs. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-billing-entitlements: As documented in Stripe's 2026-05-13 Dashboard and API guide, Stripe Entitlements maps internal product features to Stripe Products and tracks customer entitlements through subscriptions. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-invoices: Stripe's subscription-invoice guide covers first invoices, renewals, saved-default payment-method fallback, draft invoice changes, voiding, and metadata propagation. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-checkout-subscriptions-qui: Stripe Billing's hosted [[stripe-checkout]] subscription quickstart demonstrates a product with a recurring Price, a Checkout Session in `subscription` mode, a customer portal, and webhook and entitlement guidance. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-acss-debit: Stripe's Canadian pre-authorized debit (ACSS/PAD) subscription guide describes server-side Subscription creation and client-side Stripe.js `stripe.confirmAcssDebitPayment` for bank details and mandate acknowledgment. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-amazon-pay: The 2026-05-13 Stripe guide describes three Amazon Pay subscription paths: Setup Intents API, Payment Intents API, and a Stripe-hosted Checkout page. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-billing-analytics: Stripe Billing's Dashboard analytics guide defines recurring-revenue, subscriber, trial, churn, retention, and usage metrics. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-becs-debit: Stripe's Australian BECS Direct Debit subscription guide uses a Dashboard Product and recurring Price, a server-created SetupIntent, client-side Australia Bank Account Element and DDR authorization, then a saved default payment method on a customer-configured Account or Customer before server-side subscription creation. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-bacs-debit: Stripe's Bacs Direct Debit subscription guide uses Checkout: a client checkout button calls a server endpoint that creates a subscription-mode Checkout Session with at least one recurring Price. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-billing-cycl: Stripe's billing-cycle guide explains how recurring price intervals and billing-cycle anchors align future renewal dates. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-billing-mode: Stripe's subscription billing mode guide documents the `classic` and `flexible` modes, their version-dependent defaults, creation and migration routes, and proration discount display. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
Stripe compares classic and flexible subscription billing to help an integration assess a migration. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-cancel: Stripe's [[stripe-subscriptions-cancel]] guide covers manual immediate and period-end cancellation, custom cancel dates, subscription schedules, and configured dispute-triggered cancellation. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-cash-app-pay: The 2026-05-13 combined guide describes three Cash App Pay subscription paths: Setup Intents API (save a payment method, then subscribe), Subscriptions API (create and confirm separately), and a Stripe-hosted Checkout page. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-change-price: Stripe's Subscriptions API guide describes changing a subscription item's price to upgrade or downgrade an existing subscription. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-coupons: Stripe's subscription-discount guide distinguishes coupons, which define a discount and can be applied by a backend, from customer-facing promotion codes that reference a coupon and inherit its product restrictions. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-design-integ: Stripe's subscriptions design guide helps choose a pricing model, checkout interface, and payment timing, then routes six example combinations to deeper implementation guides. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-ideal: The 2026-11-07 capture of this canonical URL is an index to hosted and Direct API variants, not either variant's instructions. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-migration-ap: API-based guide for migrating subscriptions from another processor, an in-house system, or an existing Stripe account into Stripe Billing. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-migration-to: Stripe's Dashboard Billing migration toolkit imports subscription data from a third-party, home-grown, or another Stripe account through CSV and creates scheduled Stripe subscriptions. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-kakao-pay: The 2026-05-13 capture is a full Kakao Pay subscription guide with SetupIntents-labeled, Subscriptions API, and Stripe-hosted Checkout variants. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-klarna: The 2026-05-13 Klarna subscription guide contains two paths: Stripe-hosted Checkout, which it recommends for saving Klarna as a payment method, and an advanced Payment Element integration. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-kr-card: Stripe's 2026-05-13 capture explains three `kr_card` subscription integration variants: SetupIntents, direct Subscriptions API with PaymentIntent confirmation, and a Stripe-hosted Checkout page. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-mixed-interv: The 2026-05-13 combined Stripe guide describes mixed interval subscriptions: one subscription with items that have different prices and billing periods. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-naver-pay: The 2026-05-13 capture is a full Naver Pay subscription guide with SetupIntents-labeled, Subscriptions API, and Stripe-hosted Checkout variants. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-overview: Stripe subscription lifecycle guide covering creation, initial and recurring invoices, eight statuses, payment recovery, status resolution, cancellation and access provisioning. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-pause: The November 7 Stripe guide describes true subscription pause: `POST /v1/subscriptions/:id/pause` suspends service delivery and new invoice generation without canceling the subscription. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-pause-paymen: Guide to `pause_collection` on a subscription. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-payment-meth: Stripe's November 7, 2026 guide explains that subscription `payment_settings.payment_method_types` limits the **types allowed** to pay subscription invoices; it does not select a single saved default payment method. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-paypal: Stripe's May 2026 PayPal subscription guide describes two paths: Stripe-hosted Checkout and a Direct API flow using a SetupIntent and PayPal billing agreement. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-pending-upda: Stripe's pending updates normally defer an invoice-generating subscription change until payment succeeds. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-pix: The 2026-11-07 capture of this canonical URL is a 15-line navigation index pointing to Stripe-hosted Checkout, Setup Intents API, and Subscriptions API variants. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-prebilling: Prebilling uses `billing_schedules` on a subscription to invoice licensed-price items for future service periods when creating or updating the subscription. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-prorations: Stripe's same-URL May and November 2026 guides explain proration invoice items for subscription changes, discount treatment, credit calculation in classic versus flexible billing mode, preview, and `proration_behavior`. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-revolut-pay: The May 13, 2026 full guide documents three Revolut Pay subscription paths: SetupIntents API, direct Subscriptions API plus PaymentIntent confirmation, and a Stripe-hosted Checkout page. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-sepa-debit: The May 13, 2026 guide documents two SEPA Direct Debit subscription examples: a hosted Checkout page and an advanced web integration. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-stablecoins: The May 13, 2026 full guide covers subscription payments from a customer's crypto wallet through three paths: Stripe-hosted Checkout, Payment Intents API, and Setup Intents API. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-schedules: Stripe's subscription schedules create a subscription or attach to an existing one, then apply sequential phases to automate changes over time. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-third-party: Stripe's combined 2026-05-13 guide documents two ways to use Billing subscriptions and invoices with a third-party processor: an own-processor path with custom PaymentMethods and PaymentRecords, and a separate out-of-band invoice path. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-free-trials: Both the May 12 and November 7, 2026 captures call `trial_end` free-trial periods a **legacy** integration path and recommend Trial Offers for new integrations. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-subscriptions-twint: The May 13, 2026 guide describes three TWINT subscription examples: Stripe-hosted Checkout, Setup Intents API, and Subscriptions API. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-usage-based-billing-flat-f: End-to-end Hypernian example for a flat fee plus overages: a sum meter, graduated metered price with the first 1,000 units included, separate $100 monthly licensed price, and both prices on one subscription. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-usage-based-billing-alerts: The November 7, 2026 guide describes **usage alerts** that notify an application when meter usage reaches a configured threshold. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-usage-based-billing-credit: Stripe describes Credit Grants for prepaid or promotional billing credits allocated to a customer for usage-based merchant offerings. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-usage-based-billing-config: The May 5 and November 7, 2026 same-URL guides describe a configurable invoice **finalization** grace period. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
source_descriptions.source-stripe-usage-based-billing-how-it: This guide explains **basic usage-based billing with Stripe Billing Meters**: its four-part lifecycle and six core objects. (S01 reviewed update, 2026-11-08; dated source qualifications apply.)
